name: Order Status 4 Code
definition: Specifies the current status of the order.

PACK.name: Accepted
PACK.definition: Order is accepted and is ready for execution (execution is the moment when pricing is applied).

COSE.name: Already Executed
COSE.definition: Order is already executed and confirmation has been sent.

STNP.name: Sent To Next Party
STNP.definition: Order has been sent to the next party, eg, the next intermediary.

RECE.name: Received
RECE.definition: Order has been received, ie, technical validation of the message is ok, and the message is now at the receiving side.

SETT.name: Settled
SETT.definition: Order is settled. The cash is credited or debited.

CPNP.name: Communication Problem Next Party
CPNP.definition: Communication problems with the next party.

CNFC.name: Confirmation Amendment
CNFC.definition: Order confirmation cancellation has been sent and will be followed by a confirmation amendment, or a confirmation amendment has been sent.

DONE.name: Done For Day
DONE.definition: Order has been partially filled, and is done for the day, ie, no further executions will take place today.

DONF.name: Partially Done
DONF.definition: Order has been partially filled and will not be filled further.

IACO.name: Invalid Agent Confirmation
IACO.definition: Order confirmation received from agent is invalid.
